mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% year-over-year indicates inflationary pressure, which typically leads to tighter monetary policy and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL YoY > 2% does not correlate with negative 20-day forward returns in > 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A significant drop in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4% signals a tightening labor market, which can lead to wage inflation and subsequently negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE < 4% does not correlate with negative 60-day forward returns in > 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) indicates strong consumer demand, which is a positive signal for economic growth and S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If HOUST increases do not correlate with positive 20-day forward returns in > 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in industrial production (INDPRO) signals a slowdown in economic activity, which can lead to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO YoY < 0% does not correlate with negative 60-day forward returns in > 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: When nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) increase and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) decreases simultaneously, it indicates a strong labor market, which is a positive signal for economic growth and S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the joint condition of PAYEMS > 0% MoM and UNRATE < 0% MoM does not correlate with positive 5-day forward returns in > 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in real final sales (RSAFS) indicates weakening consumer demand, which can lead to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If RSAFS YoY < 0% does not correlate with negative 20-day forward returns in > 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals a tightening monetary policy, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS > 0.25% increase does not correlate with negative 60-day forward returns in > 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) and real GDP (GDPC1) both show positive growth, it indicates a strong supply side of the economy, which is a positive signal for S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the joint condition of INDPRO YoY > 0% and GDPC1 YoY > 0% does not correlate with positive 60-day forward returns in > 60% of instances.
